readers.axt.example.v1.Appointment: {"type":"record","name":"Appointment","namespace":"axt.example.v1","doc":"An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.","axt.version":1,"axt.title":"title","fields":[{"name":"title","type":"string","default":"","doc":"What the appointment is, as plain text on one line."},{"name":"start","type":{"type":"long","logicalType":"local-timestamp-millis"},"doc":"When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock; see time_zone. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day."},{"name":"end","type":["null",{"type":"long","logicalType":"local-timestamp-millis"}],"default":null,"doc":"When the appointment ends, as a date and time on the wall clock in the time zone of start; the end itself is not part of the appointment. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day."},{"name":"time_zone","type":["null","string"],"default":null,"doc":"The IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Berlin, in which start and end read on the wall clock. Null when start and end are meant in whatever time zone the user is in at that moment."},{"name":"all_day","type":"boolean","default":false,"doc":"True when the appointment takes whole days; the times of start and end are then 00:00 and have no meaning beyond the day."},{"name":"location","type":"string","default":"","doc":"Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given."},{"name":"notes","type":"string","default":"","doc":"Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none."},{"name":"reminders","type":{"type":"array","items":"int"},"default":[],"doc":"When the user wants to be reminded, each as a number of minutes before start; 0 is at start.
